page.notes: The running head "CAP. II; §. 8." is set beside "HABAKUK"; I have included it, but the section sign reading "§. 8." is uncertain (could be "§. 5."). The marks "N." opening the paragraph on Tiberius are a stylised letter that I read as N. The „ quotation marks at the start of each line of the first paragraph are printed and are copied as they stand. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout (e.g. "septies", "scessit").
